_not: agy (Google Antigravity CLI, image-generator alt ajani) ile uretilen esya ikonlari. style her istemin sonuna eklenir. Sira: canta esyalari, yemekler, istasyon, basliklar, kartlar. pipeline/gen_icons_agy.ps1 calistirir, pipeline/icon_post.py arka plani temizler.
style: Game inventory icon in the style of the item icons of the survival game Rust: a near-photoreal 3D product render with physically based materials, slightly worn hand-crafted look, soft diffused studio lighting from the upper left, a gentle cool fill light from the right and a subtle rim light, three-quarter view from slightly above (about 30 degrees), a single object or tight group centered and filling about 80 percent of the square frame, crisp readable silhouette. Not cartoon, not illustration, no outlines. Background: perfectly flat solid pure magenta (#FF00FF) from edge to edge, no gradient, no floor, no cast shadow on the background, no reflections. No text, no letters, no border, no UI frame. Square 1:1 image.
